contexts.text: I heard miserable lamentations... SE 228.
When they fell through the fire they lamented much.
Hence a lamentable state is produced.
Hence dissociation, which... puts itself forth in lamentable states...
That the Spiritual Church lamented before the Divine. Treated of.
Then the state there is lamentable; for then come fiercenesses and cruelties.
Interior lamentation. Signified.
Because the greater the lamentation is, the more interior it is.
But this glorying of theirs was changed into lamentation-lamentum, when the Lord came into the world. Signified.
Interior lamentation, and intercession. Signified.
Most of all do (the Angels) lament over the confirmations concerning faith separated from charity...
Because the Angels have lamented before the Lord, that when they look into the world they see nothing but darkness...
(Those being infested) lament, saying that they have done good... and yet now they cannot...
The deepest lamentation over the damned state of those in the Church... Signified.
By Woe is signified lamentation over the evil with anyone, and thence over his unhappy state.
Further lamentations over the devastation of the Church. Signified.
A grievous lamentation that the Church is taken away from Him. Signified.
A lamentation over the perverted state of the Church, and finally a last lamentation, of which hereafter. Signified.
A lamentation over those who are in the internals and in the externals of the doctrine of faith alone, and thence in evils of life... Signified.
He lamented miserably.
So lamentable are the states into which they are driven.
They induced a pain in my left eye, even to lamentation.
A lamentation over all things of the Church vastated. Signified.
A grievous lamentation over the changes of the state of the Church at its end. Signified.
Mourning, and lamentation () = on account of the Church vastated as to truths and as to good.
Grievous grief and lamentation over all things of the Church. Signified.
Lamentation concerning the damnation of those who avert themselves. Signified.
Over whom there is lamentation.
Their lamentation that they are in that Church. Signified.
The lamentations of those who are natural, and still long for truths. Signified.
